title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: unified identity timeline on the Identity page
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, access-control path, beta Graph operation and product licensing are supported. The assertion that autonomy and actions are unchanged is not established by the sources, and the checklist asks readers to review identity scopes without a corresponding control row.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Tenants with roles assigned or exported before March 2, 2025 retain their current configuration.
claims.quote: Starting March 2, 2025, new Microsoft Defender for Identity tenants can only configure permissions through Microsoft Defender XDR Unified Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Tenants with roles assigned or exported before this date will retain their current configuration.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: There is no change to autonomy and actions from the timeline update.
claims.quote: Searched: "identity" "Timeline" "remediation" "no change". Read roadmap, investigate-users and January 2026 what's-new excerpt. They describe the timeline and remediation actions but do not establish unchanged action behaviour across this update.
claims.fix: Remove 'No change:' from the Autonomy & actions bullet. Retain the descriptions of the Timeline tab and the separate Overview Actions menu.
